title: Vampire Vape Tropical Kiwi Cooler 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Kiwi Cooler Nic Salt from Vampire Vape’s Tropical collection pairs the mellow sweetness of Golden Kiwi with the tangy citrus bite of Tangelo for a clean, uplifting vape with a cool exhale. Golden Kiwi brings a smoother, more tropical flavour than its green cousin—sweet and bright with a delicate finish. Tangelo adds a lively twist, balancing sweet tangerine notes with subtle grapefruit tartness and a light floral character. A subtle cooling element completes the experience, keeping the blend crisp without overpowering the fruit. Formulated with nicotine salts for faster nicotine absorption and a smoother throat hit, this 50VG/50PG e-liquid is ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) devices like pod kits and starter pens. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths. Vampire Vape e-liquids are made in the UK and known for their reliable performance and bold flavours. The Tropical collection explores vibrant fruit combinations with a modern twist. Also available in Freebase, Shortfill and Concentrate formats.
